Dear Fellows and Friends!

We are delighted to announce that our next Fellows Day will be held on 26 November (morning) at the GFF office in Leiden. This special event is an opportunity for us to come together, share experiences, strengthen our community and celebrate achievements by awarding **certificates** to those who have successfully completed their courses. Hopefully, this will motivate a few more people to speed up and finish in time – 19 November is the last day to submit your completion declaration before the event. Please contact me if you have any doubts about what is needed to finish the course!

The agenda as well as a registration form will become available in October.

We look forward to seeing many of you there and making this Fellows Day a memorable moment together!

Warm regards,

Marvin
